## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the `--exclude` default so CI jobs can omit matching files through `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that matches file basenames and logs skipped paths in verbose mode. It documents the flag and adds tests for parsing, file collection, and archive contents.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclude default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE='*.log'` set and `--exclude` omitted, the parser uses `[]`, so the archive includes `debug.log`. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` requires that “Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment include files they intended to omit.

## Suggestions

- tests/test_main.py:24 — tests — Test archive contents with no exclusions configured — With exclusions unset, the test would fail if the parser returned `None` and `main` converted it to zero patterns before collection. The assertion requires the specific list `[]`. — Maintainers would have to update the test for a parser refactor that preserves archive contents.
